OP IRON TIDE

SITUATION

OP IRON TIDE · BREAKWATER · 18 October 2026
Time hack
__:__:__
Sitac · 03
Situation log
  1. 01The NCF made its move.
  2. 02The KASATKA Landing Group sailed from Gudauta: two Ropucha landing ships carrying a mechanised battalion, escorted by a Krivak II frigate. It is steaming south-east along the coast at about 8 kt. At that speed it reaches its beach (KASATKA BEACH, 42°37'41"N 41°11'14"E) in about 105 minutes from mission start.
  3. 03At the same time the BRONZE Armoured Column came down out of the hills toward Kutaisi: 2 T-72B, 3 BMP-2, an SA-8 and a ZSU-23-4. It is moving at about 6 kt and is roughly 87 minutes from TF ANVIL (US Army).
  4. 04If the landing force gets ashore, the Georgian line on the coast is outflanked and the road to Kutaisi is open from two sides.
  5. 05TF ANVIL (US Army) is the only heavy unit north of Kutaisi: two M1A2s and two Bradleys dug in at FOB ANVIL (42°13'38"N 42°31'15"E, 3 nm bearing 024 from Kutaisi airfield). If it breaks, nothing stands between the column and the city.
  6. 06Stop both prongs today and the NCF offensive is over before it starts.
Background

Operation IRON TIDE, Day 1. 18 October 2026, 07:00 local. The Northern Coast Federation (NCF) took the Sukhumi-Babushara and Gudauta airfields four days ago. It is armed and financed from the north and fields only Russian-built equipment. Georgia asked for help, and Combined Task Force 61 answered with two carriers: CVN-71 Theodore Roosevelt and CVN-74 John C. Stennis.
